fichas.title: Indoor public pool sanitary facilities
fichas.summary: Guidance for the layout and minimum provision of separated ladies’ and gents’ sanitary facilities between changing and pool areas. The arrangement should route bathers through a shower room before entering the pool, while providing a direct return route to changing. Includes minimum movement-area dimensions and fixture provisions.
spaces: Circulation between changing and pool areas
uses: Returning from the pool to the changing area

dimensions.label: Maximum water area for stated basic shower provision
dimensions.context: Basic equipment provision applies for water area up to this size.
dimensions.ocr_raw: applies for water area up to 500 m2

dimensions.label: Additional shower provision interval
dimensions.context: Provide a further shower for every stated interval of water area.
dimensions.ocr_raw:

dimensions.label: Maximum water area for school-pool provision
dimensions.context: For indoor school pools up to this water area, one divisible shower room each for girls and boys, with five showers, is stated as sufficient.

SWIMMING POOLS

changing area

Indoor Public Pools

""7 pool area

0

The sanitary facilities include showers and toilets, ladies'
and gents' separated. Location should be between the
changing and the pool areas. The toilets should be arranged
so that, after use and before entering the pool area, the bather
has to cross a shower room --> 0 - 0. A direct route back
from the pool area to the changing area is definitely to be
recommended.
